caption: Day 1 of 30 family dinners toddlers actually eat 🤍 Chicken Alfredo Pasta 🍝 Ingredients: • 1 lb chicken breast • 3 cups pasta • ½ cup heavy cream • 1 onion • 3 garlic cloves • 2 tbsp butter • Olive oil • Garlic powder, paprika, oregano, Italian seasoning, dried parsley • Fresh parsley Directions: Season and cook the chicken → sauté garlic and onion → cook pasta in the same pan with broth or water → stir in heavy cream → return the chicken → finish with fresh parsley ✨ One dinner for the whole family = less stress 🤍 👉 I use MunchMind because it has 200+ baby & toddler-approved recipes, weekly personalized meal plans already planned for you, and grocery lists — so I don’t have to think about what to cook every day.
